look.summary_zh: 黑白 · 提亮中灰 · 中段跨度接近原值
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 144.5/255（变化 +17.0 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.041。中灰红减蓝 +0.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #DDDDDD、#AEAEAE、#5D5D5D；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #636363、#B0B0B0、#868686。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 144.5/255 (+17.0 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.041; mid-gray red minus blue +0.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #DDDDDD, #AEAEAE, #5D5D5D. Red/green/blue swatches: #636363, #B0B0B0, #868686.
look.suggested_use_zh: 黑白纪实、建筑与轮廓试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 强度低于 1 会混回原始彩色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
